title: One standard Papyrus front end for every Papyrus site
description:
Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-20): pay off front-end debt early. Every Papyrus/Markus site renders through ONE standard front end in Papyrus core (StandardMarkusProjector configured by projection.json). Sites keep only theme (CSS + tokens), brand assets, nav/redirect data and a few named hooks. Core owns: RSS and Atom feeds, sitemap with lastmod, robots, 404, canonical/Open Graph/Twitter/JSON-LD, listings/pagination/tags, accessible components, staging guard, pattern redirects as data, calls to action and forms, consent analytics.

Pilots: Distinctive Mark (sections, custom content types, hooks) and Pilobol.us (no sections: the reference case for a publication without sections). Then the small product sites (Papyrus-web, Prospectus-web, Kanbus-web, Auritus-web, Apricity-web), docs sites, the framework marketing sites that embed Markus prose (Chatticus, Tactus, Cyclotron-web; shared header/footer component), then Threat Intelligence and the read.p.apyr.us reader (no static projection today), and Anth.us last in gated phases (production).

Parity per site: every published URL before/after (status, headers, normalised DOM, head metadata, sitemap URL set, redirects, feed validity), intentional differences allow-listed with reasons.

Also: unify Markus pins (fleet ranges from 0.5.1 to git SHAs; latest 0.13.0); live gaps found in the inventory (missing sitemaps/robots on most sites, p.apyr.us 403 on missing pages, pr.ospect.us canonical ending /index.html).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Status 2026-10-21 (evening). The standard Papyrus front end runs every site; every child except one is closed with evidence.

Live: pilobol.us, pr.ospect.us, aurit.us, kanb.us, apricity.anth.us, p.apyr.us, distinctive-mark.com, threat-intelligence.anth.us, read.p.apyr.us, chattic.us, tactus.anth.us, cyclotron.anth.us, anth.us, the Markus/Biblicus/Kanbus/Cyclotron docs, and the Biased-/Hard-Decisions leaderboards. All Papyrus-front-end sites pin papyrus-newsroom 5.12.0 or later and anthus-markus 0.13.0 (PPY-a55f75).

Shipped today: kanb.us and apricity.anth.us deployed (SSO unblocked); Accept: text/markdown negotiation on tactus.anth.us (own CloudFront edge, papyrus-edge-tactus-site) and distinctive-mark.com (change set accept-markdown); aurit.us docs/examples .md twins (18 pages, Papyrus #460, Auritus-web #9-#12); page actions on guide and docs pages (Papyrus #461, #468) and Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity on every site that has page actions (docs sites included, Papyrus 5.14.0); CLI publish derives the publication kind from amplify_outputs.json (#459, verified on two deployed backends); chattic.us pipeline Verify fixed; p.apyr.us pages /standard-front-end.html and /agent-accessible.html; llms-full.txt fix for unlisted pages; humanus bundling fix for the content-actions Lambda (5.10.0 backends failed to deploy, fixed in 5.12.0, #467/#469). Papyrus-web test failure was environment (no venv), fixed in Papyrus-web #14.

Open: PPY-0609ef, every site deploys automatically on merge to main. Now owned by the dedicated DevOps agent. Evidence so far is recorded on that story: pipelines built but waiting on a human console authorisation of two CodeConnections (kanbus-production 494166748521 connection kanbus-web-github a59fcb14-cccc-4bda-b075-ea8e81b743c3; papyrus-production 712236451410 connection auritus-web-github 47db2fa9-ffa7-4879-85b4-6b1dc54c37ba, used by apricity.anth.us and aurit.us), push webhooks and V2 triggers delivered 7-20 minutes late today, GitHub Actions not starting on private repos (billing).

Known limits, not epic work: Accept negotiation cannot run on GitHub Pages docs sites or on biased-decisions.anth.us / hard-decisions.anth.us (Amplify managed edge in the legacy account; moving them means removing domain associations), documented on p.apyr.us; MCP/WebMCP (PPY-2bc3e8) re-parented under PPY-23a743 and not built. The epic stays open only for PPY-0609ef.
